description: WP-C7 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) CAPTAIN-GENERAL (Trajann Valoris, Aura, passive): friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 6" re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1. Fixture cus11e_c7_shoot (P1 Custodes' Shooting phase; Trajann 5" behind the Custodian Guard). A real token click selects the Guard; their Guardian spears are declared at the Meganobz with the phase actions the shooting panel sends and resolved by real clicks on Fast Roll / Complete Shooting. The shooting dice log names 'Captain-General: re-roll hit rolls of 1' and '... wound rolls of 1'; the Dice Log tab is opened for the screenshot. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players 0 CP; the Meganobz' wounds inflated.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_MEGANOBZ_A"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
